parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Account name to investigate (e.g. Jackal, analyst)

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: Host name to investigate (e.g. WIN11-SOC-Endpoint, ubuntu-soc-agent)

content.query:
let WindowsSignins = Event
| where EventLog == "Security"
| where EventID == 4624
| where Computer has "{Host}"
| extend Account = extract(@"New Logon:.*?Account Name:\s*(\S+)", 1, RenderedDescription)
| where Account has "{Account}"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, EventType = "Windows Sign-In", Detail = RenderedDescription;
let LinuxSignins = Syslog
| where ProcessName == "sshd"
| where Computer has "{Host}"
| where SyslogMessage has_any ("Accepted password", "Failed password")
| where SyslogMessage has "{Account}"
| extend Account = extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) password for (\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend EventType = iff(SyslogMessage has "Accepted", "Linux Sign-In (Success)", "Linux Sign-In (Failed)")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, EventType, Detail = SyslogMessage;
union WindowsSignins, LinuxSignins
| order by TimeGenerated desc

let WindowsProcs = Event
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
| where EventID == 1
| where Computer has "{Host}"
| where RenderedDescription has "{Account}"
| where RenderedDescription has_any ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "certutil.exe", "rundll32.exe")
| extend ProcessImage = extract(@"Image:\s*(.+?)\s*FileVersion:", 1, RenderedDescription)
| extend CommandLine = extract(@"CommandLine:\s*(.+?)\s*CurrentDirectory:", 1, RenderedDescription)
| extend Platform = "Windows"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessImage, CommandLine, Platform;
let LinuxProcs = Syslog
| where ProcessName == "audispd"
| where Computer has "{Host}"
| where SyslogMessage has "type=SYSCALL"
| where SyslogMessage has "success=yes"
| where SyslogMessage has_any ("comm=\"nc\"", "comm=\"curl\"", "comm=\"wget\"", "comm=\"python3\"", "comm=\"bash\"")
| extend ProcessImage = extract(@"exe=""(.+?)""", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend CommandLine = extract(@"comm=""(\w+)""", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend Platform = "Linux"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessImage, CommandLine, Platform;
union WindowsProcs, LinuxProcs
| order by TimeGenerated desc
